items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I wanted to be Louis Armstrong or Roy Eldridge or one of those kind of cats.

ctx.x: Yeah, he could sing all those numbers of that guy, Dick Gray, was singing. So we had Joe with us, and Joe loved it, of course being there with Ella Fitzgerald. I remember we battled, our band and Joe, we battled Louis Armstrong’s band and Ella Fitzgerald. And you know it was like this all night long.
I think you should explain a battle. How did that work, you know?
